# Japanic Attack

> > Your comprehensive guide to traveling Japan, covering Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, Fukuoka, and beyond with detailed itineraries, accommodation reviews, and transportation tips.

Japanic Attack provides first-hand travel guides and practical advice for exploring Japan's major cities and regions. The site features detailed itineraries, attraction guides, accommodation reviews, and essential planning resources for both first-time visitors and returning travelers.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo attractions and neighborhoods
- Osaka and Kansai region travel
- Fukuoka and Kyushu exploration
- Kyoto temples and cultural sites
- JR Pass and Shinkansen travel
- Ryokan and traditional accommodations
- TeamLab digital art museums
- Observation decks (Shibuya Sky, Harukas 300)
- Trip planning and itineraries
- Budget travel options
- Seasonal travel guides
- Day trips from major cities
- Hotel and accommodation reviews
- Transportation IC cards and trains
- Mount Fuji and Nara day trips

- [How Long Should You Stay in Japan? Trip Length Guide (2025)](https://www.japanicattack.com/post/how-to-plan-the-perfect-length-for-your-trip-to-japan): Trip duration planning guide for Japan covering Tokyo, Osaka, Fukuoka visits
- [Transportation in Japan: Trains, JR Pass & Travel Tips](https://www.japanicattack.com/transportation-in-japan): Complete guide to Japan transportation: Shinkansen, JR Pass, IC cards, trains
